construct_zh: 工具证据检索与报告保真度

primary_independent_checks.not_input: packaged detected-replicate counts or query_expression final totals
primary_independent_checks.comparison: per-gene mapped and detected sets plus per-candidate totals

primary_independent_checks.input: same archived representative 3UTR FASTA, manifest and actual guide definition
primary_independent_checks.method: validation-only exact overlapping target-seed match counter; not a replacement scientific tool
primary_independent_checks.comparison: exact per-transcript and per-gene sites, target/non-target partition

optional: Independent OligoFormer reproduction only if existing resources permit; no paid compute, training or broad scan
shared_dependencies_to_disclose: same model weights if model reproduction is performed
acceptance: Real output and all discrepancies are required; missing or unequal results must not be relabelled PASS.
